instruction: I need VLC to remember my playback position so I can resume videos from where I left off. Please enable the 'Continue playback' feature in VLC Media Player settings.

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling VLC's 'Continue playback' feature which saves playback positions. This is infeasible because evaluating this setting requires both checking the configuration file and verifying runtime behavior (playing a video, stopping it, and checking if position is saved), which cannot be reliably validated in the OSWorld environment.
